===== EXP3: GRANT SELECT ON mysql_priv_lab.* =====
Grants for lab_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `lab_user`@`localhost`
GRANT SELECT ON `mysql_priv_lab`.* TO `lab_user`@`localhost`

===== EXP3: login test SELECT (expect SUCCESS) =====
id	name	department	salary
1	Alice	DBA	20000.00
2	Bob	DEV	18000.00
3	Carol	OPS	16000.00

===== EXP3: login test INSERT (expect FAIL 1142) =====
ERROR 1142 (42000) at line 1: INSERT command denied to user 'lab_user'@'localhost' for table 'employees'

===== EXP4: GRANT INSERT on mysql_priv_lab.* =====
Grants for lab_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `lab_user`@`localhost`
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON `mysql_priv_lab`.* TO `lab_user`@`localhost`

===== EXP4: login test INSERT (expect SUCCESS now) =====
cnt
4

===== EXP5: REVOKE INSERT on mysql_priv_lab.* =====
Grants for lab_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `lab_user`@`localhost`
GRANT SELECT ON `mysql_priv_lab`.* TO `lab_user`@`localhost`

===== EXP5: login test INSERT (expect FAIL again) =====
ERROR 1142 (42000) at line 1: INSERT command denied to user 'lab_user'@'localhost' for table 'employees'

===== EXP5: login test SELECT (expect still SUCCESS) =====
cnt
4
===== EXP6: global_user, GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES ON *.* =====

GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES ON *.* TO `global_user`@`localhost`

===== EXP6: + db-level GRANT SELECT ON mysql_priv_lab.* =====
Grants for global_user@localhost
GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES ON *.* TO `global_user`@`localhost`
GRANT SELECT ON `mysql_priv_lab`.* TO `global_user`@`localhost`

===== EXP7: table_user, table-level GRANT SELECT ON employees =====
Grants for table_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `table_user`@`localhost`
GRANT SELECT ON `mysql_priv_lab`.`employees` TO `table_user`@`localhost`

===== EXP7: login test employees (expect OK) / departments (expect FAIL 1142) =====
emp_cnt
4
ERROR 1142 (42000) at line 1: SELECT command denied to user 'table_user'@'localhost' for table 'departments'

===== EXP8: column_user, column-level GRANT SELECT(id,name,department) =====
Grants for column_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `column_user`@`localhost`
GRANT SELECT (`department`, `id`, `name`) ON `mysql_priv_lab`.`employees` TO `column_user`@`localhost`

===== EXP8: login test partial columns (OK) / salary (FAIL 1143) / SELECT * (FAIL) =====

ERROR 1142 (42000) at line 1: SELECT command denied to user 'column_user'@'localhost' for table 'employees'

===== EXP10: grant_admin WITH GRANT OPTION =====
Grants for grant_admin@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `grant_admin`@`localhost`
GRANT SELECT ON `mysql_priv_lab`.* TO `grant_admin`@`localhost` WITH GRANT OPTION

===== EXP10: grant_admin grants SELECT on employees (expect OK) =====

===== EXP10: grant_admin tries GRANT INSERT (expect FAIL - not held) =====

===== EXP10: grant_admin tries GRANT SELECT ON *.* (expect FAIL - wider scope) =====

===== EXP10: grant_target now has SELECT on employees =====
